title: Part 1 keyframes.json
description: The key frames of each repetition, per person, on the clock of the original video. t_ms is the time every consumer joins on. frame is the same moment as an index at fps. Extra keys may appear and are ignored by readers. See CONTRACT.md.

format.description: Version id. A change that breaks a reader gets a new id.

video.description: The original video, relative to the Part 1 repo root, for example inbox/<name>.mp4.

fps.description: Frame rate of the original video. keyframes[].frame counts frames at this rate.

analysis_fps.description: Rate of the analysis copy the models watched (15 for a clip of 20 s or less, else 8). It sets the time resolution of t_ms. Written by make keyframes.

spark_names.description: spark: pose names came from Muse Spark. fallback: the generic start, bottom, top. Written by make keyframes; hand labels omit it.

quality.description: The local quality report. A refused video writes no keyframes.json, so verdict is fine or enhanced. Written by make keyframes; hand labels omit it.

people.description: Each person Part 1 kept. An empty list means nobody moved enough to count.

id.description: SAM object id from Part 1's own tracking run. It is not Part 2's person id.

movement.description: snake_case section name from Spark, or movement when none applies.

frame.description: round(t_ms / 1000 * fps): the frame of the original video at this moment.

t_ms.description: Milliseconds from the start of the original video. Consumers join on this.

reviewed.description: Hand labels only: true when a person moved or added this pose.
